design_philosophy.concept: Tactile Literary Journal & Sensory-Safe Writing Sanctuary
design_philosophy.description: Designed like a high-end physical notebook and classic printing atelier. Warm linen backgrounds, muted charcoal typography, serene contrast, and zero visual clutter. Specifically tailored for long-form prose, uncensored creative freedom, character evolution mapping, and deep ADHD/autism focus.
anti_patterns_forbidden: No generic tech-gradient backgrounds or glowing purple (#7351B7)
No centered paragraph body text (body prose must be left-aligned)
No inter-everywhere font usage for headings or long-form prose
No unstyled/transparent floating dropdowns that overlap text
No sudden flashing animations or aggressive timer popups

primary_serif_prose.usage: Long-form story editor, chapter titles, prose excerpts, character backstories

dyslexia_friendly_font.usage: Toggleable via Accessibility Toolbar for neurodivergent readers

ui_sans.usage: Navigation, buttons, accessibility controls, badges, character stats, timer

type_scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight
type_scale.h4: text-lg font-sans font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase text-xs text-muted-foreground
type_scale.body_prose: text-lg sm:text-xl font-serif leading-relaxed text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
type_scale.label: text-xs font-sans font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-900/70 dark:text-amber-200/70

writing_editor.description: Distraction-free canvas with live word count, reading time, line/paragraph focus mode, and typewriter auto-centering.
writing_editor.explicit_content_badge: Explicit-Friendly Writing Workspace (Unfiltered Creative AI Freedom)

controls: Font Selection (Lora, Cormorant Garamond, OpenDyslexic, Sans)
Sensory Theme Picker (Warm Sepia, Calm Sand, Midnight Slate, High Contrast)
Reduced Motion Toggle (Disables all non-essential CSS transitions)

adhd_session_timer.features: Subtle progress ring, ambient sound toggle, non-jarring visual break prompt, customizable intervals

modes: Analyze Tone & Pacing (Subtext, emotional tension, sensory detail)
Revise & Polish (Explicit dialogue, prose rhythm, show vs tell)
Expand Scene (Continue story from current cursor position)
ai_collaborator_panel.tone_policy: Uncensored & explicit-friendly for adult literature, dark fantasy, romance, and gritty drama.

features: Character Cards with profile image, role, traits, motivations, and secrets
Evolution Timeline across chapters (e.g. Chapter 1: Innocent -> Chapter 5: Disillusioned -> Chapter 12: Vengeful)
Psychological Arc Chart (Internal motivation vs External action)

states.saved: All changes saved to cloud & local storage

layout_architecture.left_sidebar: Projects, Chapters, Scenes, Character Roster, Settings (Collapsible, 260px wide)
layout_architecture.center_stage: Distraction-Free Sheet Reader / Prose Canvas (Max width 820px, auto-margins, generous padding)
layout_architecture.right_sidebar: Dual Tabbed Panel: AI Collaborator & Character Arc Tracker (Collapsible, 340px wide)
layout_architecture.top_header: Compact Header with Project Name, Chapter Selector, Accessibility Drawer Toggle, ADHD Timer, and Auto-Save Pill

responsive.layout: On mobile screens (< 768px), sidebars transform into smooth off-canvas drawers or bottom tab bar; editor takes 100% width with touch-friendly toolbar.
responsive.typography: Fluid scaling (rem-based) so font size controls work uniformly across mobile and desktop.
responsive.overflow_guard: Strict overflow-x-hidden on root viewport; editor scroll region isolated to center area.
responsive.tap_targets: All buttons, toggles, and dropdown triggers minimum 44px x 44px with 8px touch spacing.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete fullstack creative writing web application in /app/frontend and /app/backend.
Ensure Lora or Cormorant Garamond font is loaded via Google Fonts in index.html.
Implement the Accessibility Toolbar with real-time state changes modifying CSS CSS variables or body classes (font size, line height, letter spacing, dyslexia font, sensory themes).
Ensure the AI Collaborator endpoint connects to backend Claude 3.5 Sonnet / Claude 5 service with explicit content permission enabled for fiction writers.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='focus-mode-toggle', data-testid='ai-analyze-btn', data-testid='character-save-btn', data-testid='autosave-status').
Implement the character evolution tracker with interactive chapter nodes and psychological trait sliders.
Use sonner for non-intrusive, calm toast notifications for autosave confirmations and timer breaks.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_rule: Every button, input, toggle, select, tab, modal trigger MUST have a distinct data-testid in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Dropdown menus and select menus MUST have a solid/semi-solid sensory background with backdrop-blur and a clear border.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.hover_state_contrast: Always explicitly define hover text colors alongside background hover colors.
